purpose: Palette-corrected design concepts; application UI unchanged
paletteSource: harness/crates/theme/src/builtins.rs (codegraff_light and codegraff_dark); default selection documented in harness/docs/theme-system.md

variants.title: 1 — Paper · Harness colors
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, an existing Nanohub UI concept. Produce one high-fidelity flat desktop screenshot, same landscape framing and dimensions. Preserve its overall layout, repository information, file rows, README, and navigation. This is a new version of the concept, not an app implementation.
Primary request: Use the actual default palette from the user's Harness repository at crates/theme/src/builtins.rs, Codegraff Light/Dark, instead of invented brand colors. Maintain Nanohub's three-dot brand, do not replace the brand with Harness or GitHub. Fonts follow Harness: Geist-like clean sans serif and Geist Mono-like hashes. Crisp readable text and exact alignment; opaque flat surfaces, no gradients, atmospheric lighting, paper texture, glow, blur, or glass.
Keep these exact labels and values: "nanohub", "nanohub-test", "git-ui-fixture", "Private", "Code", "Issues", "Pull requests", "Actions", "Agents" with "2", "Settings", "main", "Branches", "History", "Go to file", "Clone", "Local fixture", "Local hosting UI fixture", "fb9c17b", file table "Name" and "Object", ".github" and "dee77aa", "README.md" and "b44dbf2", README title "Local repository fixture", body "Synthetic data for testing owner/repo addresses and the Actions queue.", About text "Git repository hosted on Nanohub."
Header cleanup: The top application bar should contain only the Nanohub wordmark, "Repositories", "New repository", and a small account avatar. Do not add a global search, Explore, Organizations, Help, star, fork or other invented controls. Keep the real repository file finder in its toolbar. Preserve all other layout details of the edit target. All controls should look practical and shippable.
EXACT HARNESS LIGHT PALETTE: page/canvas #faf8f3; shell/navigation chrome and card headers #f0ece3; raised/selected surfaces #e7e1d5; text #1a1813; muted text #6b6557; faint metadata #a8a090; primary amber accent #c77d20; success #5c7e47; danger #b14228. Borders black at about 12% opacity over the cream surfaces. The primary Clone action should be AMBER with DARK #1a1813 lettering, never green or teal or blue. Use amber for folder icons, selected navigation markers and interactive emphasis, sparingly. Repository owner/name stay dark neutral. Do not introduce terracotta/rust, mint, purple, teal or GitHub blue as brand accents.
Preserve the Paper concept's horizontal navigation and quiet document-like hierarchy. Only change palette, fonts if necessary, and the specified header cleanup. Use opaque cream content surfaces with subtle warm-gray borders; no texture.
